scope: Independent floor review; source analysis and existing scripted browser probes, not a configured RewardKit or portal grade
source_observations: Render gate judge.toml:25 requires a new marker and two chosen integers, an authored JavaScript addition, and the computed output in both preview and console. Source text or copied literals alone fail.

Constraints gate judge.toml:25-27 requires a new UI save, observed server response, and matching identity/title/filename/source retrieved through the normal UI in an independent clean browser context and again after reload. A static seed or localStorage copy fails.

tests/test.sh:213-227 runs gates before scored dimensions; tests/tools/score.py:41-48 sets reward 0 if either gate fails or scored functional score is at most 0.05. tests/scoring.toml:2-11 gives gates zero weight and scored weights 0.6/0.2/0.2.
Functional, polish and visual prompts each restate the browser prerequisite; polish assigns 0 and visual raw anchor 1 if it fails. Visual raw anchor 1 normalizes to 0.

The Render gate is intentionally limited to one ordinary successful JavaScript run, and Constraints permits server-rendered records without a JSON endpoint or specific database engine. External/CDN application assets are permitted.
